questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q:
Use the clues and write 4–5 sentences on:
Healthy Habits (Clues: exercise – food – water – health)
questions.ans: Healthy habits keep us fit. I exercise every day. I eat nutritious food and drink plenty of water. These habits help me stay active and healthy.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q:
Use the clues and write 4–5 sentences on:
My Favourite Sport (Clues: game – friends – playground – fitness)
questions.ans: My favourite sport is kabaddi. I play this game with my friends every evening. We play on the school playground. Kabaddi makes me strong and quick. It keeps me fit.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q:
Use the clues and write 4–5 sentences on:
Yoga and Health (Clues: yoga – body – mind – calm)
questions.ans: Yoga is a good exercise. It makes our body flexible and strong. It also keeps our mind calm and fresh. I do yoga every morning. Yoga helps me concentrate on my studies.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q:
Use the clues and write 4–5 sentences on:
Staying Fit (Clues: morning – exercise – healthy food – energy)
questions.ans: I wake up early in the morning. I do exercise for half an hour. Then I eat healthy food like fruits, milk and vegetables. This gives me energy for the whole day. Staying fit makes me happy.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q:
Use the clues and write 4–5 sentences on:
Strong Nation (Clues: citizens – health – fitness – progress)
questions.ans: A nation is made of its citizens. When citizens are healthy, they can work hard. Fitness gives them energy and a sharp mind. Healthy and fit people help the country make progress. So a fit nation is a strong nation.

questions.q: Your friend eats junk food every day. What advice will you give?
questions.ans: I will tell him that junk food harms health and advise him to eat fruits, vegetables and home-made food.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: Your class is organizing a sports day. How can you participate?
questions.ans: I will take part in races and games, help arrange the ground and cheer my friends.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: Why should students exercise regularly?
questions.ans: Regular exercise keeps students healthy and active and helps them concentrate on studies.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: A friend feels tired all the time. What healthy habits would you suggest?
questions.ans: Sleep early, get up early, exercise daily, eat healthy food and drink enough water.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: How do sports help students?
questions.ans: Sports keep students fit and active and teach teamwork and discipline.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: How can you help your family stay healthy?
questions.ans: I can remind them to drink water, eat healthy food and exercise or walk with them every day.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: Why should we drink enough water every day?
questions.ans: Water keeps our body hydrated, helps digestion and keeps us active.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: What healthy food do you eat at home?
questions.ans: I eat rice, ragi ball, chapati, dal, vegetables, fruits and milk.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: How can family members exercise together?
questions.ans: They can go for a morning walk together, do yoga together or play games in the evening.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: Why should we avoid too much junk food?
questions.ans: Junk food has too much oil, salt and sugar; it gives no nutrition and makes us sick.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: How can a community encourage fitness?
questions.ans: By building parks and playgrounds, holding yoga camps, sports events and walkathons.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: Why should parks and playgrounds be maintained?
questions.ans: So that children and adults have a safe and clean place to play, walk and exercise.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: How can sports bring people together?
questions.ans: People play and watch games together, cheer for their team and become friends.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: What can you do to promote healthy habits among friends?
questions.ans: I can share healthy snacks, invite them to play and exercise with me and make posters on health.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: Why does a nation need healthy citizens?
questions.ans: Healthy citizens can work hard and contribute to the nation's progress.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: Why is good health important?
questions.ans: Good health helps us live happily and work efficiently.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: How does exercise improve our life?
questions.ans: Exercise keeps our body strong and active and our mind fresh.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: Why should we develop healthy habits?
questions.ans: Healthy habits prevent illness and improve our well-being.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: How can sports teach discipline?
questions.ans: In sports we follow rules, practise on time and obey the captain; this teaches discipline, teamwork and responsibility.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: Why should children stay physically active?
questions.ans: Physical activity supports children's growth and development and keeps them healthy.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: Why should we care for our body and mind?
questions.ans: A healthy body and mind help us perform better in everything we do.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: Why should we encourage others to stay fit?
questions.ans: Fitness benefits everyone; when all are healthy, the family, society and nation become strong.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: What value did you learn from this lesson?
questions.ans: I learnt the value of health, discipline, fitness and responsibility.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: Write a slogan on fitness or health.
questions.ans: Stay Fit, Stay Happy! (or) Healthy Body, Healthy Mind.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: What would happen if people stopped exercising and eating healthy food?
questions.ans: People may become unhealthy and weak and fall sick more often.

questions.chapter: 7. Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation
questions.q: What healthy habit will you start or continue after reading this lesson?
questions.ans: I will exercise every day, eat healthy food, drink enough water and stay active.

Lagori (Clues: stones – ball – team – excitement)
questions.ans: Lagori is a traditional game. Seven flat stones are stacked one on another. A player from one team throws the ball to knock them down. That team tries to rebuild the stack while the other team tries to hit them with the ball. The game is full of excitement.

questions.q: Your team is losing a game. How will you encourage your teammates?
questions.ans: I will tell them not to give up, to stay calm and play together; we can still do our best.

questions.q: A friend is not included in a game. What will you do?
questions.ans: I will invite him to play with us and ask others to include him.

questions.q: Why should students participate in sports?
questions.ans: Sports keep students healthy and teach teamwork, discipline and confidence.

questions.q: How can teamwork help during school activities?
questions.ans: When we share work, it gets done quickly and well, and everyone enjoys it.

questions.q: What should you do if your team loses a match?
questions.ans: We should accept the defeat gracefully, congratulate the winners and practise more.

questions.q: How can you work as a team with your family?
questions.ans: We can share household work like cleaning, cooking and gardening.

questions.q: Why is cooperation important at home?
questions.ans: Cooperation makes work easier and keeps the family happy and united.

questions.q: How can you help your brother or sister complete a task?
questions.ans: I can share the work, bring the things they need and explain what they do not understand.

questions.q: What games do you play with your family?
questions.ans: I play carrom, chowka-bara, ludo and hide-and-seek with my family.

questions.q: How does teamwork make work easier?
questions.ans: When many people share the work, each one has less to do and the work finishes quickly.

questions.q: Why should traditional games be encouraged?
questions.ans: They are part of our culture, need little equipment, give exercise and teach teamwork.

questions.q: How can you help organize a sports event?
questions.ans: I can help prepare the ground, arrange things, list the players and keep the place clean.

questions.q: Why are teamwork and cooperation important in society?
questions.ans: They help people solve problems together and live in peace and unity.

questions.q: How does practice help us improve?
questions.ans: Practice helps us correct our mistakes and become better and more confident.

questions.q: Why should we respect our teammates?
questions.ans: Respect builds trust and friendship, so the team plays well together.

questions.q: What qualities make a good champion?
questions.ans: Hard work, practice, discipline, teamwork and respect for others.

questions.q: Why is sportsmanship important?
questions.ans: Sportsmanship means playing fairly and respecting others whether we win or lose; it keeps games friendly.

questions.q: How can games teach discipline?
questions.ans: In games we follow rules, wait for our turn and obey the captain and referee.

questions.q: How do traditional games help children?
questions.ans: They keep children active, improve their skills and teach them about our culture.

questions.q: How can we handle victory and defeat gracefully?
questions.ans: In victory we should not be proud and should respect the losers; in defeat we should not be sad but congratulate the winners and try again.

questions.q: What value did you learn from this lesson?
questions.ans: I learnt the values of teamwork, cooperation, practice and sportsmanship.

questions.q: Write a slogan on teamwork or sports.
questions.ans: Teamwork Makes Champions! (or) Play Together, Win Together.

questions.q: What might happen if the players did not work together during the Lagori match?
questions.ans: They could not rebuild the stones in time, would quarrel and would lose the match.

questions.q: How will you use teamwork in your daily life?
questions.ans: I will share work at home and school, help my friends in group work and cooperate with everyone.
